caseNameFull: Dimock v. Corwin, Late Collector of Internal Revenue
attorneys: Messrs. E. J. Dimock and J. D. Rawlings for petitioner., Solicitor General Jackson, Assistant Attorney General Morris, and Messrs. Sewall Key, J. Louis Monarch, and Edward J. Ennis for respondent.

opinions.text:
Petition for writ of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Second Circuit granted.

Mr. Justice Stone took no part in the consideration and decision of this application.
